answer: A farm generating text without memory of its own history thus fails the binding, thus it has to store and read state per alias. Bindings are kept in vertex, verified in crystal, and the chain is public. Each challenge is bound to the identity's previous 3 answers, so the new answer must be consistent with them or be rejected at the dune check. A farm of 2577 identities would post 1563 proofs and burn roughly 79 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted.
